entry.description: Entry path within the installed package (relative to its node_modules root) used when embedding the package into a generated surface.

integrity.description: The package's sha512 dist.integrity. After `pi install` the installer compares the integrity npm recorded in pi's npm-root package-lock.json with this value and stops on a difference.

allowInstallScripts.description: The reviewed reason this companion needs its dependency lifecycle scripts. Absent: the install runs with npm_config_ignore_scripts=true.

skills.description: pi package-filter patterns for the skills this companion bundles, written onto its settings.json entry by the installer: [] loads none, "!pattern" excludes one. Absent: every skill the package ships is loaded. An entry that already has a skills filter is left as it is.

retired.description: Companions the kit no longer ships. The installer (and so /update and /profile) unregisters one only when the install marker records that the kit added it; one the user registered is kept.

package.description: The npm package name; any `npm:<package>@<version>` source of it matches.
